source.title: 2026 State Control Programme for Food Safety

interpretation_limits: The 750 figure is the programme's planned annual sampling count, not evidence that 750 samples were actually collected or tested.
The plan describes 550 base drinking-water samples calculated as K=1.5 multiplied by A=365, rounded from 547.5, plus approximately 200 additional bottled-water samples.
The document states that monitoring of produced bottled-water volume is not planned; no production-volume denominator is supplied.
No sample-level results, analyte-specific denominators, location-level coverage or actual completion counts are contained in this planning extract.
The planned count must not be used as a prevalence denominator or represented as an observed compliance rate.
